p: Light source, knife or any slash weapon
tx:
Although they (or some other weight-reducing item) are required during Temple of Ikov, they are still obtainable and wearable by any member, even if the player hasn't started the quest.
To access the item, a light source and a knife or any weapon with a slash attack is needed to get to them (the knife on the tool belt will work). Climb down the ladder to enter the Temple of Ikov. Head west along the main corridor until arriving at a staircase (). Make sure the light source is lit and go down the stairs. Go to the small north-east area and try to slash the spiderweb; it may take a few tries. The boots respawn in 58 seconds, making it very convenient to pick up several pairs on a single visit. Disabling AoE looting will speed this up, since there is a knife spawn next to the boots.
sc: They are found on the ground of the second level of the Temple of Ikov south of Seers' Village.

tx:
An unfinished masterwork magic draft for the robe bottom must first be created at the pattern table, consuming all of the items, after which it can be worked on using the tailoring process to create it. Crafting this item requires a total of 30,000 progress; 9,000 at the drafting table and 21,000 at the tailor's dummy (as an unfinished masterwork magic robe bottom). At the default rate of 20 progress every 4 ticks (2.4 seconds), this takes 6000 ticks, or 60 minutes. This time may be increased or decreased by interacting with focus windows.

tx:
Buckets of slime can be obtained with relative ease. For the quickest collection possible, it is advised to wear the Morytania legs 2 or better for their pool of slime teleport, and a near-bank teleport, such as War's Retreat Teleport, the TokKul-Zo or attuned crystal teleport seed. Weight-reducing clothing is also advised. 
To obtain the slime, use the Morytania legs' teleport or the ectophial. If using the ectophial, use the trapdoor directly west of the ectofuntus then head down to the pool. There is a shortcut between the upper and middle floors of the basement which requires level 58 Agility to use. Once at the pool, click on it to collect the slime, teleport to a bank, then repeat. The players do not need to bring empty buckets; buckets will be provided during the process.
Using buckets of slime on magic notepaper or enchanted notepaper notes the buckets of slime, allowing a large amount of slime to be collected in a single trip (using the notepapers on the buckets doesn't work). The players can expect around 2,800 buckets per hour with notepaper. Buckets of slime can also be stored in beasts of burden.
1,200 buckets of slime will be needed if the players plan on getting the First age outfit.
The players can obtain buckets of slime and bonemeal from Robin in exchange for bones. The amount varies depending on the progress with the Morytania achievements. The players can obtain 26 buckets of slime a day after completing the hard Morytania achievements, and 39 buckets a day after completing the elite Morytania achievements.
Ten buckets can also be bought daily from Lupe in the City of Um after completing the hard Underworld achievements.
sc: The bucket of slime is a bucket filled with ectoplasm from the Pool of Slime, found on the lowest floor of the basement of the Ectofuntus.
Empty buckets were previously required to obtain buckets of slime from the Pool of Slime.
It is obtained from the Gun Locker aboard Bill Teach's ship.
